title: applied-ml-weekly-notes-2026-08-18
content:
Week: 2026-08-12 -> 2026-08-18
Owner: Priya Nair (applied-ml)
Status: draft  working notes and experiment logs for quantization pipeline, eval results, and onboarding checklist for Llama-3-13B & Mistral-8B variants.

Summary:
- Focus this week: close iteration on quantization pipeline (int8 + fallback int4 path), run regression evals on the internal eval suite, and finalize onboarding checklist for Llama-3-13B & Mistral-8B variants.
- Ran production-like perf tests on Dedicated (p3x-equivalent) and Private (VPC) environments. Early results show promising memory+latency improvements with int8 + kernel tweaks; still investigating a small degradation on open-domain QA accuracy.

Highlights / Quick wins:
- Int8 dynamic quant (per-channel activations) + new kernel schedule reduced 13B p99 latency from ~86ms to ~63ms (single-request, 32-token prompt) on RTX-A6000 class testbed. Memory footprint reduced ~42% vs fp16.
- Added automated fallback path: if token-latency or perplexity deviation exceeds thresholds, route to fp16 variant for first N tokens. Implemented in runtime PR #789 (link above).
- Baseline evals (redwood-internal-eval-suite-v2) passed regression gates for summarization (+/- 1.2 BLEU equiv), small drop observed on multi-hop QA (exact match -1.8 pts).

Experiments  quantization:
1) int8-dynamic + kernel-schedule-v3
   - Setup: Llama-3-13B (hf export), runtime-kernels-v3, batch=1, prompt=32 tokens
   - Perf: p50 28ms -> 21ms, p95 64ms -> 46ms, p99 86ms -> 63ms
   - Mem: alloc reduced from 21.3GB -> 12.4GB (approx 42% reduction)
   - Quality: Rouge-L on summarization set stable; multi-hop QA EM -1.6.
   - Notes: kernel-schedule-v3 uses fused attention matmul path for last 4 layers; good perf regression on longer contexts.

2) int4 (mixed) prototype
   - Setup: layerwise mixed int4 where first 6 layers use int8, last 18 layers int4; quant-calibration with 2k calibration tokens
   - Perf: memory down to ~9GB, latency similar to int8 due to slower emulation kernels
   - Quality: significant drop on reasoning tasks (EM -4.8), unacceptable for rollout.
   - Action: deprioritize int4 for 13B until fast int4 kernels land upstream; record design in quant-profiles confluence page.

Evals / regression testing:
- Suite: redwood-internal-eval-suite-v2 (summ, codegen-smoke, multi-hop-qa, safety-filter-test)
- Results summary (int8-dynamic vs fp16):
   - Summarization ROUGE-L: 0.72 -> 0.719 (within threshold)
   - Safety false positives: stable
   - Multi-hop QA EM: 0.56 -> 0.544 (regression alarm threshold = -0.02; observed -0.016 -> below alert but we should monitor)
   - Codegen basic tests: no regressions observed
- Next steps: expand eval set to include new customer prompt-suite (CS-templates v3) to ensure real-world coverage.

Model onboarding notes (Llama-3-13B, Mistral-8B):
- Onboarding checklist (working):
   1) Model artifact pulled and verified (SHA + tokenizer compatibility)
   2) FP16 baseline performance (p50/p95/p99) measured on Dedicated and Private envs
   3) Tokenization sanity (special tokens, length behavior)  run tokenization fuzz tests
   4) Quantization profiles created (int8 dynamic; int4 candidate) + calibration datasets noted
   5) Evals run: redwood-internal-eval-suite-v2 + customer prompt-suite
   6) Safety and toxicity checks + blacklist testing
   7) Canary config + rollout policy drafted (canary 5% then 25% then 100%)
   8) Billing metrics and per-token cost estimate documented
   9) Documentation: model card + known regressions
- Blocker: Mistral-8B tokenizer had a different unk-token behavior; worked with DevEx to patch tokenizer wrapper (PR submitted).

Standup / meeting notes (08-17 quick standup):
- Priya: finalized kernel-schedule-v3 tests; pushing perf numbers to dashboard; follow-up on int4 kernels with infra. TODO: add new perf traces to observability (trace id RWI-2301).
- Ethan: ran extended evals overnight; found specific failure pattern on multi-hop QA related to prompt templates with list enumerations. Investigating whether recalibration helps. TODO: open ticket with sample prompts ML-482.
- Maya: validated canary config for canary rollout; drafted rollback policy; working on cost-per-token calc for Dedicated.
- Lina: patched tokenizer wrapper for Mistral-8B; need another pass from DevEx before merge.

Blockers / Risks:
- Small regression on multi-hop QA could affect customers using retrieval-augmented generation. Need targeted evals with RA-gen prompts.
- Int4 kernels are not yet fast in our runtime  holding off on production int4 rollout for 13B models.
- Canary automation for dedicated autoscale + fallback needs one more SRE review (ticket SRE-1293).

Action items / next week:
- Priya: run RA-gen specific evals for int8 pipeline; include retrieval contexts (deadline 2026-08-24).
- Ethan: triage multi-hop QA failures and propose mitigation (recalibration vs early-token fp16 routing) by 2026-08-21.
- Maya: finalize cost-per-token model and add to model card; draft customer-facing note for expected perf changes.
- Lina: coordinate with DevEx to land tokenizer wrapper patch and run full onboarding checklist for Mistral-8B.
- Team: schedule a 30-min sync with SRE+Runtime to unblock canary automation (owner: Priya).

Quick links / references:
- Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789
- Linear tickets: ML-482 (multi-hop QA examples), SRE-1293 (canary autoscale review)
- Confluence: quantization-profiles (internal design + calibration datasets)

Notes to self / loose ideas:
- Try per-layer mixed precision heuristics driven by sensitivity score instead of fixed layer splits. Potential to get int4-like memory with int8 quality.
- Evaluate using distilled calibration sets sampled from production prompts to reduce QA regressions.
- Consider adding a "first-token-fp16" option in runtime to preserve generation stability for 2-3 initial tokens (cheap and possibly effective).

Attachments / artifacts to push to drive:
- perf-traces-2026-08-17.zip (perf traces for kernel-schedule-v3)  pushed to S3 (link in ML-482)
- eval-results-int8-2026-08-18.csv (summary table)

End notes: documented incremental wins but caution on QA regressions. Focus next week on targeted evals and an SRE sync to make canary reliable.

-- Priya
